title: Microsoft to Allow Customers to Claim Digital Entitlements Through Physical Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S Discs
content: By inserting a supported physical game disc into an Xbox One or Xbox Series X, players will be able to download and play that game digitally, including Xbox Play Anywhere and Xbox Cloud Gaming support, without needing the disc. The disc will continue to work.
author: ANN

title: Naruto’s Strangest Stage Play Reveals Live-Action Look Before Konoha’s Hollywood Debut
content: Lionsgate and Spider-Man: Brand New Day director Destin Daniel Cretton are planning to bring to life a brand-new take on the Hidden Leaf Village. With a live-action Naruto movie set to arrive in the future, this is far from the first time that a live-action project focusing on Konoha has landed.

title: Actor Tim Curry Dies at 80
content: Curry was born on April 19, 1946 in Grappenhall, Cheshire, England. He had a major stroke in 2012. Curry is perhaps best known as Dr. Frank-n-Furter in the 1975 musical film The Rocky Horror Picture Show and The Rocky Horror Show musical.
